map_tesseract_script: map a tesseract script name to its canonical form, converting Katakana and Hiragana to Japanese, Han to HanS, and Korean to Hangul
parse_tesseract_orientation: parse a tesseract orientation string (0, 90, 180, 270) and convert it to a counterclockwise bounding rectangle angle in [0, 360)
tesseract_box_to_bounding_rectangle: convert a tesseract bounding box to a BoundingRectangle with rotation, scaling, and optional offset applied
